physical_governance_policy.rationale: A durable checkpoint is required for audit, but the controlled raw well identifier may not be materialized.

lineage_scope.boundary: Ordinal record Lineage V4 supports one row-identity-preserving source with one unique STRING key. It is not falsely applied to this four-source spatial many-to-many Join.

certificate_boundary: PARTIAL is required: independent checks bind plan, planner decision, policy/data snapshots, result digest, event DAG, and source lineage, but do not cryptographically attest every DuckDB-internal operator output.
stop_conditions: Do not execute when either Agent validation outcome changes.
Do not rank a candidate before hard governance feasibility filtering.
Do not execute a candidate rejected by the physical governance policy.
Do not report PASS unless all six frozen faults are rejected.
Do not relabel this semantic case study as optimizer latency evidence.
